en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large rectangular Renaissance-style palace or castle on a hill above a town. The long multi-windowed building with hipped roofs and dormers dominates the scene, with terraced gardens or walls in front and smaller town houses with tiled roofs below. The caption "Bilin Schloss" is printed in red at the top left, and a vertical red publisher's imprint appears along the right edge.
